method.rotations: SO(3) shortest-log spatial angular increments (no Euler subtraction); acceleration is vector velocity first difference. Local expressed in pre-local bone axes, world in fixed world axes. All frames included, maxima zero-based.
method.spectra: Hann one-sided periodogram after linear detrend, components summed. 3/4/6 Hz inclusive through Nyquist 12Hz; % denominators exclude DC. Position spectra and angular-velocity spectra are different, not interchangeable.
method.attribution: Diagnostic-only counterfactual replaces one component by 4th-order zero-phase 3Hz Butterworth smoothing in SO(3) log coordinates, or removes all local/global high frequency jointly. Never writes motion. Magnitudes are not additive causal shares; high frequency is not proof of error; no GT amplitude fidelity claimed.
method.units: Angles deg; speed deg/s; acceleration deg/s^2. Keypoint and translation coordinates rig world units, normalized values explicitly use rig.size. UV studio-panel px.
